title: How a 19 mm Lug Nut Stops Fitting a 19 mm Socket
topic: Two-piece capped lug nuts can swell or deform so the original socket no longer fits
mechanicTruth: Some factory lug nuts use a two-piece capped design; deformation or corrosion beneath the outer cap can increase the outside dimension enough that the original-size socket no longer fits correctly, even though the thread size itself did not change.
